_note: The cover of each brand: one photograph filling the first screen, with these words over it. Change the words here and they change on the site. To change the photograph, replace photos/_covers/ithos.jpg or cathelier.jpg with a landscape picture and run scripts/covers.py.
_note_film: "film" plays a short silent film over the cover photograph on laptops and larger screens. Delete the line and the photograph stays, with nothing to undo — on phones and for anyone whose device is set to reduce motion, the photograph is what shows anyway. Changing the film itself is not a back-office job: the new recording goes in _materiais-ithos-cathelier/filmes/ and somebody runs scripts/film.sh.
